notes.title: Happy first anniversary!
notes.notes:
Hi, we're celebrate a year! This was my first commercial game, and if you've played it, you'll notice a few issues, like the damn Elias's walk. Despite everything, I'm happy with the result and the reviews. I tried to generate empathy with some fictional characters who, at least for me, seemed real for a moment, and I spent my time talking about them as if they were old (except for Gamberno and Raúl).
I regret to announce that, for now, I won't be able to update the game due to certain issues that everyone constantly pointed out to me. I'm having various difficulties that are not relevant right now, but I'm also trying to create a new point-and-click game, trying to avoid all the rookie mistakes I made with this game.

I hope you're having a good time.
Sincerely, Marcial Gutierrez

P.S. If you play the game today, April 17th, you'll see a secret message that appears only on that day. You can also see it.
